teaching.title: Lecturer in Computer Science & Engineering
teaching.description: Appointed as **Lecturer** in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering at World University of Bangladesh, Dhaka. Dedicated to **academic excellence**, **student mentorship**, and **knowledge dissemination** in cutting-edge technologies. Responsible for delivering high-quality education in **Artificial Intelligence**, **Machine Learning**, and **Software Engineering** while fostering innovation and research culture among students.

teaching.title: Research Mentoring & Knowledge Sharing
teaching.description: Engaged in mentoring junior students and sharing research insights through academic discussions and collaborative projects. Contributed to knowledge dissemination in the fields of **Artificial Intelligence** and **Natural Language Processing**, particularly focusing on Bengali language processing and machine learning applications.

teaching.title: Leadership Development & Training
teaching.description: Participated in comprehensive leadership training program designed to develop technical leadership skills and mentorship capabilities. Gained experience in **knowledge sharing**, **team collaboration**, and **professional development** within STEM fields.
